rankings.summaryHtml: The Hawks' 17-0 January was the best month this league has ever seen. But the week that capped it was undeniably rough for a team that hasn't lost since the day after Christmas. Thabo Sefolosha is out, DeMarre Carroll is ailing, and this week's schedule is daunting with a capital D.

rankings.summaryHtml: Bad timing for the Dubs to have, as Steve Kerr contends, lost their edge. They have dropped two of three and, on top of Friday's much-hyped stop in Atlanta, will play 11 of 13 games on the road. No other team has such a stretch on its schedule this season.

rankings.summaryHtml: Three more wins will establish Gregg Popovich as just the ninth coach in league history to reach 1,000 wins. Yet something tells me he's far happier with the Spurs' 10-4 January after that brutal 8-10 December. Especially with the annual Rodeo Road Trip looming Sunday and running through Feb. 28.

rankings.summaryHtml: Nothing has gone according to the script for the Cavs. Nothing. A home win Monday night over Philly, mind you, will take LeBron & Co. to a season-high 10 games over .500.

rankings.summaryHtml: In the longest homestand in franchise history, Phoenix went 6-2, and the team has gone 16-7 since a 12-14 start. The downside: A 2-7 mark in games decided by three points or fewer means that the Suns are better in one-possession games than only Indiana (2-10), New York (1-5) and Minnesota (1-4).

rankings.summaryHtml: The Bulls suffered four two-game skids in January to cap the month at a worrisome 8-9. Also at least mildly troubling: Newly minted All-Star Jimmy Butler's scoring average has declined for three successive months, from 21.9 PPG in November to 21.5 PPG in December to 17.6 PPG in January.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Pelicans are a flat-out enigma. They are a heady 18-12 against the rest of the West but a costly 7-10 against the East. They are also a promising eighth leaguewide in offensive efficiency but tied for 22nd with Denver in defensive efficiency despite employing The Brow and Omer Asik.

It happened in 1981-82 as well to Houston and Kansas City.
